title: Intangible
description: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to [blue]1[/blue] this turn.
smart_description: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to [blue]1[/blue]. Lasts for [blue](stack counter)[/blue] turns.
notes: Damage cap is reduced to 1 unless the dealer has The Boot relic and the target is not the player creature, in which case it's 5. Ticks down at the end of each enemy turn.
